ledger.x: c. 344 BC: the kingdom exists from the 4th century BC. The infobox gives 'Established: 4th century BC' and a ruler list opening '344-310 BC: Aylimas (?)'; the page names no founding event, year or extent beyond the Mulucha in the west.
206 BC: Syphax takes the east of the Massylii kingdom.
206 BC (bridge): the seat goes east to Cirta.

c. 203-202 BC: Masinissa unifies Numidia. 'He succeeded in defeating Syphax and unified Numidia (c. 203-202 BC)'; Syphax 'died in Tibur in 203 or 202 BC'; the Masaesyli infobox annexes the kingdom to Numidia only in 175 BC.

wars.name: Syphax against the Massylii
wars.outcome: Syphax attacked the Massylii (undated, after his Roman alliance of 213 BC) and after Gala's death in 206 BC conquered considerable parts of the eastern kingdom; Masinissa and Oezalces quarrelled over the inheritance.

wars.name: Second Punic War in Africa
wars.outcome: Syphax met Scipio and Hasdrubal Gisco at Siga in 206 BC and later allied with Carthage (Gisco's daughter Sophonisba, no year); at the Battle of the Great Plains in 203 BC 'Scipio overcame Gisco and Syphax'; Laelius and Masinissa pursued him to Cirta and he…

certainty.note: The pages give one river in the west and 'Constantine' in the east, with no dated frontier; the Oranais and the Tell provinces are the researcher's.
